entities.summary: Yuna Kagesaki  is a manga artist, born on March 3, 1973, best known for being the author of the manga Chibi Vampire. Her work has been published under four different names: Yuna Kagesaki , Yuna Kagezaki , Yūna Kagesaki  when drawing CG's for PC games, and Yuta Kageyama  when drawing hentai manga or HCG's for PC games. In the bonus comic strips at the end of volume 3 of her work Hekikai no AiON, she refers to herself as "K-ya " , suggesting that her real name begins with "K" and ends with "ya".
